evidence.section: Flow cytometric characterisation of B cells and plasma cells
evidence.quote: Purified, CD19 + B cells, re-suspended in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS)-EDTA + 0.5% bovine serum albumin (BSA), were added at 2 × 10 5 cells per well of a V-bottom, 96-well culture plate in a 50-μl volume. The B cells were then labelled with a combination of the above antibodies to give: (1) plasma cells, which were viable (PI − ) CD3 − CD14 − CD16 − CD19 + CD20 lo/- CD38 hi CD27 hi with subsets based on expression of CXCR3 and HLA-DR; (2) memory B cells, which were viable (PI − ) CD3 − CD14 − CD16 − CD19 + CD20 + CD43 − CD5 − CD27 + with subsets based on IgM and IgD expression (IgM + only, IgM + IgD + , IgD + only and switched IgM − IgD − ). The cells were analysed on a Beckman-Coulter Cyan Flow Cytometer with 9-colour parameters.

Serum bactericidal assay.readouts: bactericidal antibody titres against meningococcal serogroups A and C

evidence.quote: Human complement serum bactericidal assays (SBAs) for detection of meningococcal serogroups A and C were performed at Vaccine Evaluation Unit, Public Health England, Manchester. Serum samples collected at days 0, 28 and 56 were assessed for human SBA activity against serogroup A (F8238) and serogroup C (C11). SBA titres were expressed as the reciprocal end point serum dilutions yielding ≥50% killing of bacterial colonies after 60 minutes of incubation compared with growth at time 0.

B-cell enzyme-linked immunospot assay.readouts: frequencies of antigen-specific memory B cells and antibody-secreting cells

evidence.quote: PVDF 96 well plates (Millipore) were coated with 100 μl of either 5 μg/ml (capsular group A and C) of purified meningococcal polysaccharide (National Institute for Biological Standards and Control (NIBSC) 98/722 and 07/318) conjugated to 5 μg/ml methylated human albumin (NIBSC), 10 μg/mL diphtheria toxoid (Statens Serum Institut 2675) or phosphate-buffered saline (background control). Memory B cells were assessed using cultured ELISpot performed on blood samples collected at days 0, 28 and 56. PBMCs were suspended in R10 at a concentration of 2 × 10 6 cells/ml.
